description.value: Edge Outdoors is a small outdoor clothing and gear shop based in Qualicum Beach on Vancouver Island, carrying waterproof jackets, footwear, camping supplies, optics, and kids' outdoor apparel. The shop has an active local presence and caters to people heading into the natural surroundings of the Qualicum Beach area. Touring cyclists passing through would find it a useful stop for outdoor gear and clothing but should not expect bicycle-specific services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is Edge Outdoors' Instagram page, which confirms the business is a real outdoor clothing and gear shop in Qualicum Beach, BC. The Instagram posts describe camping gear, waterproof apparel, kids' outdoor clothing, and similar items — there is no mention of bicycles, bike repairs, bike rentals, or any cycling-specific services. No phone number, street address, or bike-related amenity is corroborated by the Instagram content, so all bike-service criteria remain null.

The 'Bike Services' category is almost certainly wrong and should be corrected to an outdoor/gear shop category, but this does not warrant exclusion.
